inspection_method: Each final PDF page rendered at 145 dpi by Poppler and opened individually with the image-viewing tool. Observations recorded after inspecting all 12 final04 page images.

pages.observation: Title, author accents, date and pending-review status are separated and readable. Abstract and four-claim boundary table fit; no clipping.
Geometry definitions and equations (1)-(4) are legible. Chart metric and inherited premises remain distinct; page number and footer are clear.
Physical plane and factorization, Proposition 1 and all 13 residual classes fit. Six zero labels and inward residual rows are readable; source note is below the table.
All three accepted figure panels inspected. E05+, E16-, E21+, E09+, E17+, E10- are legible in each panel; no cropped labels. Panel values and common-scale caption are clear.
Uniform support/side requirements, equation (10), ordered-field sign explanation and endpoint-deflated Sturm argument are legible and unclipped.
Ridge-closure lemma and complete classification theorem fit. All five count rows and facet histograms are readable; transition/radius identities and final paragraph stay above footer.
All five representative cycles, six/38/12/6 readout and two endpoint-limit rows are legible. Tables occur between complete paragraphs; endpoint attachment statement is intact.
Scoped no-ten-vertex corollary, scaling/reflection scope and all three computation evidence layers are clear. Bernstein equation and trust qualification fit without spillover.
Evidence paths wrap cleanly; table sits between complete paragraphs. Pending status and assistance statement are intact. All four bibliography entries fit and are readable.
Appendix chart/group convention and first seven C1 rows are legible. Exact fractions, cycles and orbit sizes do not overlap; table continues at a row boundary.
Repeated C1 header and remaining two C1 rows are clear. All eight transition rows fit, including six-member hexagon orbit; final source note stays inside body area.
All nine C2 representatives, offsets, orbit sizes and full cycles fit. Long second-row normal is unclipped; no blank or extraneous final page.

scope: Document and figure-label readability, not a scientific recertification.
